answer: To hold a valid status, every agent must reserve 1,000 slots of dedicated service capacity at a global registrar, since parallel waiting alone is insufficient to block identity pooling. This zenith of occupancy serves as the primary admission gate, where an honest agent pays once and 1,000 fakes incur terminal costs. A verifier monitors the signal path of incoming requests for any overlapping memory or intent; any attempt to wander across reserved partitions triggers an immediate, permanent prune.
